entry.title: Adding Runtime NuGet Package Loading to an Application
entry.summary:
One of the tool applications I've built sometime ago and use a lot, is my LiveReloadWebServer local Web server. It's a local .NET based Web server that you can point at a folder to serve as a Web site. It supports static content with Live Reload, has support for loose Razor Pages (.cshtml) and built-in themed Markdown file rendering among other things. It's a useful tool to have in your quiver to quickly fire up a local client Html app, or to create static sites locally and work on them interactively. Since it has live reload you can quickly make changes and see them rendered in real-time.
